prompt.generated_prompt_string: Generate a high-fashion winter editorial portrait with a cinematic luxury aesthetic in an alpine environment. An adult woman sits on a sculpted block of ice, wearing a black oversized puffer jacket, white wide-leg snow pants, white winter boots with red laces, a plush white fur hat, and white winter gloves. One gloved hand rests gently against her cheek; her expression is relaxed yet powerful. Surround her with smooth rolling snowdrifts and dramatic snow-covered alpine mountains beneath an overcast winter sky. Use soft diffused natural light, a centered minimal composition, 85mm shallow depth of field, photoreal fabric and ice texture, cool blue-white-gray-black palette, and an ultra-clean luxury editorial feeling.
prompt.negative_prompt: minor, explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized pose, nudity, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, logo, readable text, extra fingers, deformed, blurry
